name: Rabshakeh
title: Assyrian commander under Sennacherib
summary: Rabshakeh was a high-ranking Assyrian official whom King Sennacherib sent against Jerusalem. He mocked King Hezekiah and ridiculed the God of Israel in the hearing of the people on the wall, but his army was later struck down by the angel of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Mocks Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Rabshakeh stood before the walls of Jerusalem and mocked Hezekiah and the God of Israel to persuade the people to surrender.
